jobs.title: Medical Sales Representative
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Medical Sales Representative to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in pharmaceutical or medical supply sales across the East African market.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Pharmacy, Biomedical Sciences, or related)
Minimum 2 years experience in medical or pharmaceutical sales
Willingness to travel across the region
responsibilities: Develop and maintain client relationships with healthcare facilities
Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets
Provide product knowledge and consultative guidance to clients
Monitor market trends and competitor activities
Submit regular sales reports to management
